text:
leo: Heads up — billing alert overnight showed ~ $9.6k unplanned charge tied to GPU fleet in us-west1 :eyes:
mia: ouch. any quick root cause?
leo: digging. autoscaler events show a template push at 02:12 that removed the 'preemptible: true' flag on the gpu-pool nodeTemplate. autoscaler then ramped to max (we had maxNodes=120) and filled with on-demand GPUs
ops-bot: [02:12] autoscaler: scaleUp start -> target=88 nodes (policy=cpu_utilization)
leo: also noticed the nodeTemplate's instanceType changed from n1-highmem-8 to n1-standard-32 — higher baseline + GPUs = big delta
sam: who merged that template change?
mia: I see a PR from infra/terraform by jia merged at 02:10 that updated the node pool to a new image; the preemptible var was accidentally set to false in the new module call
jia: that was me — sorry, I swapped env var order in the TF module and didn't notice the default. I can revert.
billing-bot: Invoice snippet: "project:redwood-prod | resource:gpu-nodepool-us-west1 | usage: 88 nodes | duration: ~5.9h | cost:$9,612.42"
leo: thanks. two more complications: 1) our regional commitment (3yr reserved capacity) is in us-central1, so this didn't get applied; 2) autoscaler spread across three zones due to topologyPolicy allowing cross-zone which multiplied provisioning overhead
sam: I scaled the pool down to minNodes=0 and forced cordon/drain on excess nodes at 03:04. current running GPU nodes: 6
mia: how long did it run at peak?
leo: peak from 02:15 -> 08:05 per cluster metrics (~5h50m). billing shows charges for entire lease window ~6h
jia: pushing a hotfix now: revert module change + add explicit preemptible=true in nodeTemplate and add a terraform plan check to block non-preemptible GPU pools in prod.
ops-bot: [03:05] alert: fleet-scale anomaly detected — retrospective ticket AUTO-1273 created
sam: couple of follow-ups: 1) add a gate in CI that rejects changes to nodeTemplate.preemptible without explicit approval, 2) add daily spend cap alert for GPU projects, 3) set sensible maxNodes per pool (we had too-high limit)
leo: agree. also add monitoring rule: if scaleUpRate > 20 nodes/5m then pause new scale-ups and notify pager
mia: can we apply existing reserved commitment to future auto-fills? or move some capacity to us-west1 commitments?
jia: ops vs finance: finance, can we shift some of our regional commitments or buy a smaller short-term committed use discount for us-west while we stabilize?
finance (out-of-thread note): we'll sync — moving commitments mid-term has penalties, but we can evaluate 1-month committed discounts.
billing-bot: Billing extrapolation: if this repeats monthly, annualized waste ~ $115k.
sam: please file an incident postmortem with timeline, root cause (TF var order+no preemptible gate+maxNodes misconfigured), and remediation steps. I'll own the mitigations list.
leo: immediate actions: rollback TF change (jia), CI gate (sam), add autoscaler rate-limit (sam), create spend alert (mia), finance consult (jia).
mia: noted. I'll also add a dashboard widget for reserved-commitment utilization by region so this kind of mismatch is visible.
jia: pushing hotfix and will follow up with PR link in this thread. again — my mistake, sorry.
leo: thanks for fast triage. add retro item: require explicit "gpu_preemptible=true" in module signature so it can't be omitted. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: [04:10] incident AUTO-1273 status: open, severity: S2
leo: closing loop — cost reclaimed for this event is none (on-demand charges already incurred) but we prevented further drift. will write up postmortem this morning and tag finance + product owners.
